_comment: EVERY MEASUREMENT CLAUDE.md ASSERTS ABOUT OURSELVES, and the artifact that produces it. Run at batch 45 after the contrast claim was found to be a specific measured number with nothing behind it. The tooling sweep asked which rules never ran; this asks which numbers never came from anywhere. The test is one question per number: name the thing that computes it.

verdicts.no-artifact: Nothing has ever computed this. The number came from nowhere identifiable.
verdicts.stale-snapshot: An artifact computes it, but the copy written into CLAUDE.md is a frozen snapshot and has drifted. Lower severity — the truth is one command away — but the prose still states a wrong number.
verdicts.spec-enforced: Not a measurement. A design decision, and the validator enforces it.

claims.claim: Contrast is verified by script: 22 pairings across both themes, all passing WCAG AA.
claims.evidence: git log --all --name-only has no contrast/a11y/colour file ever added or deleted.
claims.truth: 30 pairings, 0 below AA, once scripts/check-contrast.mjs was written to produce the number.

claims.claim: 79% of every record is hand-written prose.
claims.evidence: No script computes a prose share. Measured directly at batch 45: 65% of record bytes are hand-written prose fields.
claims.truth: 65%, and the denominator moves as structured fields are added — `catalogue` and `entity` both landed this batch, which is exactly why a frozen percentage about our own records decays.
claims.note: The number was load-bearing: it was the stated reason the bottleneck was 'the prose, not the quota'. That conclusion happened to survive the correction, but it rested on a number nothing produced.

claims.claim: 29 of 180 populated categories have a dissenting voice (16%).
claims.evidence: coverage-report.mjs computes and prints it every run.
claims.truth: Recomputed live on every report. The CLAUDE.md copy lags by whatever has been added since.
claims.fixed: pointed at the artifact instead of restating the number

claims.evidence: coverage-report.mjs MAPPING PROVENANCE section computes it.
claims.truth: 6 of 326, 1.9% — the numerator held and the denominator nearly doubled, which halved the share while the prose kept the old one.

claims.claim: 29 of 196 creators carry no practitioner badge; the share runs 100% to 14%.
claims.evidence: validate.mjs fails on drift in the stored domain-notes measurements; coverage-report prints the live saturation table.
claims.truth: Live in the report. The prose copy is from batch 26.
claims.fixed: left as a dated historical statement, since it is describing a past finding rather than the current state

claims.claim: AU has no creator in 11 of 12 flagged categories, UK in 9, CA in 8, US in 7.
claims.evidence: coverage-report.mjs has a jurisdiction-gap section that recomputes it.

claims.claim: Max 4 primary categories per creator, hard max 6.
claims.evidence: validate.mjs fails a record exceeding either. Not a measurement — a decision.

claims.claim: A signal is saturated at 70% of a domain's creators; domains under 4 creators are not measured.
claims.evidence: Thresholds in scripts/lib/saturation.mjs, applied on every report.

_theRule: Any number in this file that describes US — our records, our rigour, our process — must name the artifact that computes it, in the same sentence. If no artifact exists, either build it or delete the number. A measurement with no producer cannot be checked, cannot be corrected, and is the only kind of claim that never even gets the chance to be wrong.
